parse.title: Izo (Black Fire)
parse.text:
If you were looking for a different Izo unit, see Izo (disambiguation).

Overview

Izo (Black Fire) is a MythicalMythical unit. He is only obtainable through summons. He is also the boss of stage 5 of Storm Hideout in The Final Confrontation.

Evolving

Izo (Black Fire) can evolve into Izo (Samurai) with the following materials:

Why do I have different stats?
Units in this game use a randomized system, where stats like damage are randomly rolled with about a 10% variance (like Dungeon Quest items). When you evolve a unit they also reroll their stats, but it will always be strictly better than the pre-evolved version.
